edbDesc: The heating or cooling of a current-carrying conductor with a temperature gradient Depending on the material it may cause heating or cooling. One of a number of thermoelectirc effects (see Seebeck effect and Peltier Effect).
title: Thompson Effect
pickWhy: The Thomson effect's heating or cooling is tiny and swamped by ordinary resistance heating, so no device uses it; the Peltier and Seebeck effects do the work.
